overview_description.description: Jupe is a hospitality product technology startup producing the next evolution of shelter, designed for discovery. We manufacture base camps for the bold, created to escape the ordinary, offering shelter in extraordinary places (from music festivals to farms to forest to natural disaster areas for relief housing). Jupe is a flat-packed dwelling unit inspired by the stars, designed for new frontiers beyond the city that can be set up in just two hours. These minimalist, modular units remove limitations and redefine access to natural habitats and off-grid living. We operate a production facility in Southern California and support a growing list of customers looking to invigorate their hospitality offerings across the globe. Dimmable LED track lighting, a continuous double-battery system, bedside USB charge stations, and outlets integrated throughout are all features of Jupe shelters.
